newsitem.title: USA: TVA halves output at Tenn nuclear plant.
newsitem.headline: TVA halves output at Tenn nuclear plant.

text.p: Power output was cut to 50 percent at Tennessee Valley Authority's (TVA) 1,170 megawatt (MW) Watts Bar nuclear power plant, the Nucler Regulatory Commission (NRC) reported Friday.
The cut was needed to repair leaking condensor tubes at the Spring City, Tenn., plant, the NRC said. It did not indicate when the unit likely would resume full production.
The TVA, as a matter of policy, declines to comment on operations at its power plants.
Temperatures in the Tennessee Valley/Northern SERC region served by TVA are expected to rise above their seasonal norm this weekend, the Weather Services Corp said Friday.
